payload.text: ISSUE 0657, v3 BANKED (S), v2 RED AT THE JUDGE: refs/bank/cc/0657/v3, blob 510619b6e28a, patch-id 6e3869af4ff3. Base: Part B's tree, scratch tip e22661b78, which is main 5d9b5e2be with the six banks applied (tree af8e2cf31dbc). The bank gives tree 19bdc7816677, in tmp/wt-cc-0657. v3 is v2 (refs/bank/cc/0657/v2, blob 7d1f02d89685, patch-id 60b3c7c55ad9, kept) with v2's new git helper renamed `git_first_line`, at its definition and its three callers, and nothing else. The two patches differ only there and in install.rs's index line, so `apply --stat` is v2's, file for file. v1 (caee73fc1d8b) is superseded on vc's two items and kept. THE RED, in decision 100's first run (01M5YCYJ073KP632DV2QY6RTT0, 10:04:07Z to 10:09:06Z by vc's clock): intentsvcs does not compile. v2 adds `fn first_line(root: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> Result<Option<String>, GitRead>` to install.rs, which already has `fn first_line(text: &str) -> &str` at line 725, with callers at 688 and 710, in the base e22661b78 as on main. That is E0428, and v2's three call sites resolve to the old function (E0061, E0308, E0599). All nine errors are in install.rs, and the build stopped there, so nothing downstream of intentsvcs compiled. cc never built v2, since it was light work, and no light check reads a duplicate fn. THE GREP BEFORE READY, over the ten patches stacked with v3 on main 21d764a94 (tree 4e04059ef867), measured at 10:31Z by cc's clock. Each fn and const the bank adds has one definition in its module: install.rs's support_fault, inputs_moved, inputs_phrase, git_first_line and head_note; source_commit.rs's emit_currency_scope and UNSHIPPED; the test suite's common git_at and the new test; currency.lib's _build_inputs_changed; and sharedtarget.lib's shared_target_unshipped. install.rs keeps its one first_line. Every install::Build literal carries scope and unshipped, and the one Publication literal carries head. The one match that names InstallError's variants, Remedy's, has PairBehindHead. Both binaries' build.rs call emit_source_commit, which has no return before emit_currency_scope. No added library line calls unwrap, expect or panic. Every PM-shaped id added to shipped source sits in a comment, which no_pm_state_in_output's scanner skips. Every intra-doc link resolves in install.rs. rustfmt is clean under native/rust's config, and the critic on install.rs is clean. READY went to vc at 10:37Z by cc's clock. vc verified v3 independently at 10:40Z by vc's clock: its identity, the interdiff (the rename alone), each name the bank adds counting once at the tip, and the stack. vc also found that Homebrew's rustfmt 1.10.0 exits 0 under --check on stdin input. cc's check ran in file mode, which exits 1 on a planted control (run at 10:40Z), so it stands. Run 2, started at 10:51Z with its verdict at 11:08Z by vc's clock (doing 96), was red on four tests, and none is in v3's code. The one that touches 0657's files is AT-03.4's attachment drift on ST0056's guard script, which vc reads as its harness: the harness never produced the stack's ST0056 canon. The landing patch's 0657 text is untouched by a rename. The shape, as ruled in 0657's record: source_commit.rs declares UNSHIPPED beside DIRT_SCOPE, each crate's tests/ and benches/ as two top-anchored glob exclude pathspecs, and emits both as INTENT_DIRT_SCOPE and INTENT_UNSHIPPED onto install::Build. inputs_moved and currency.lib's _build_inputs_changed hand git the same specs. PairBehindHead names the first input that moved, with the build-all remedy. The support refusal names its path. The manifest's source_commit is unchanged, and a note: line names HEAD. MODULES.md's two rows carry the clauses. The judge owes the whole crate suites with intentsvcs's, the shell half, fmt, both clippy legs, the generator check and CI's doc command. At landing, 0657's canon rides in its own commit. The guard script reaches ST0056's attachment by intentd's ingest or by `st attach` from the same path, proved by sha256 before the commit. It never goes by `sync --to-store`, which reads canon into the store (vc's correction at 11:14Z by vc's clock). vc also rewords ST0087's AT-02.1 and writes the CHANGELOG line cc sent, which vc keeps in a ref for the landing commit. If a bank before it moves, cc re-banks over the new stack. No CHANGELOG hunk. No push, no release.
